content:
**Martial Artist** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

This perk reduces the weight of melee weapons as well as increases the speed at which they can be used.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Your melee weapons weigh 60% less, and you can swing them 30% faster. | 003E9569 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Your melee weapons weigh 40% less, and you can swing them 20% faster. | 003E9568 | 
| ★ | 1 | Your melee weapons weigh 20% less, and you can swing them 10% faster. | 003E9565 |
